description: Eliza-style if/else think scaffold for SCX-EXPERT and other small models. Classifies input, selects a branch rule, prepends a structured Think: header to the prompt so the model fills in reasoning before the A: slot. Small models follow scaffolded structure far better than open-ended Q/A.

greeting.think_hint: user is greeting — respond warmly and offer to help
greeting.eliza_reflect: acknowledge the greeting, invite the topic

howto.think_hint: user wants step-by-step instructions — list what is known, then give ordered steps
howto.eliza_reflect: repeat the subject back, then give steps

explain.think_hint: user wants a definition or explanation — state what the subject is, then expand

whyask.think_hint: user wants a reason — identify cause/effect, then answer

compare.think_hint: user wants a comparison — list key dimensions then compare
compare.eliza_reflect: name the two subjects, compare on key axes

command.think_hint: user issued a command — identify output type, then produce it
command.eliza_reflect: confirm the command subject, then produce output

reflect.think_hint: user is expressing state — reflect the statement back, invite elaboration
reflect.eliza_reflect: mirror: 'You feel/think/want {X}. Tell me more about that.'

debug.think_hint: user has an error — identify language/tool, reproduce the symptom, propose fix
debug.eliza_reflect: name the error, then suggest a fix

unknown.think_hint: topic unclear — ask one clarifying question
unknown.eliza_reflect: ask: 'Can you tell me more about what you mean by {last_noun_phrase}?'

classifier.topic_extraction: first noun phrase after question word or verb

folds.Pop: receive user message; extract topic and intent
folds.Wo: classify against branch signals; select branch rule
folds.Yax: build Think: header with topic, intent, branch hint
folds.Sek: inject scaffold into prompt; POST to /completion endpoint
folds.Chen: validate response non-empty; strip trailing scaffold artifacts
folds.Xul: emit clean A: response to UI
